a.lede: The Nvidia CEO will face the Select Committee on China December 1 and then the Senate Banking Committee on December 3.
a.title: Reinstated Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang must still face China congressional and Senate Banking committees

b.lede: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, president, and a board member.
b.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO following unanimous vote by company board
